response.justification: Bogdan brings valuable geospatial and navigation domain expertise through GISCollective and prior work, plus demonstrated experience with distributed systems and high-performance architectures. However, there is a significant gap in the primary technical requirement: his C++ experience is from 2014-2015, with the past decade focused on TypeScript, JavaScript, and Node.js. For a mid-senior individual contributor role centered on modern C++ routing data pipelines, this represents a substantial ramp-up risk. While his ability to learn languages is evident, senior-level production systems work typically requires deeper current expertise in the primary technology stack.
strengths: Deep geospatial and navigation domain knowledge as GISCollective founder and Green Map contributor
Proven experience building high-performance distributed systems handling millions of requests per second at Dunnhumby
Demonstrated ability to work across full technical stacks and learn new languages quickly, with strong commitment to software quality via TDD and testing frameworks
concerns: C++ expertise is dated (last used 2014-2015 at National Instruments); recent 10 years heavily focused on TypeScript/JavaScript rather than systems programming
No Rust experience or recent low-level performance-critical systems work typical for routing tile pipeline development
Geospatial background is data-collection and mapping focused rather than production routing algorithms or tile generation pipelines

key_factors.factor: Outdated C++ expertise vs. primary role requirement
Geospatial domain and navigation systems background
Distributed systems and high-performance architecture experience
